description: Copilot Studio TicketAnalysis rows for System Administrator. Maker table in env cc72ef22-bdee-e93a-a41f-db16e6d3fe0c. Prefer this custom table over Case (incident).
primaryNameNote: Display name is Title. If Title is a custom/renamed primary column, logical name is likely cr458_title. Maker default primary is often cr458_name. Confirm from column properties.
authReason: No DATAVERSE_*, POWERPLATFORM_*, or Entra client secrets in this explorer. The table exists in Maker. The explorer never calls Dataverse.

assignment.note: User or team ownership. Assign Owner to a user in the System Administrator role. Do not use a Case queue.

preferOver.reason: Release Watch tickets are not customer cases. A custom table avoids the Case queue and Customer Service Hub dependency.

choiceSets.source: Maker choice values. Do not use 211460000–211460003.
Maker choice values. Do not use 211460010–211460011.
choiceSets.note: Feature 644640000 and Deprecated 644640001 overlap numerically with Critical/High. Bind by column (Severity vs Change type), not by int alone.

columns.note: Use this if Title is a custom primary column. Else bind TicketAnalysis.title to cr458_name.
Maker default primary Name column. Confirm from column properties whether the primary is cr458_title or cr458_name.

makerSteps: Release Ticket already exists in Maker for environment cc72ef22-bdee-e93a-a41f-db16e6d3fe0c.
Table properties: display name Release Ticket, plural Release Tickets, schema name cr458_ReleaseTicket, logical name cr458_releaseticket, type Standard, ownership User or team.
Column prefix is cr458_. Primary display name is Title — bind TicketAnalysis.title to cr458_title if Title is custom, otherwise cr458_name. Confirm from column properties.
Severity (Choice, single): Critical 644640000, High 644640001, Medium 644640002, Low 644640003.
Change type (Choice, single): Feature 644640000, Deprecated 644640001. Bind by column.
In Copilot Studio, Create a new row on cr458_releaseticket. Assign Owner to System Administrator. Do not create Case (incident) records.
